belief: God only blesses people who succeed.
origins: Cultures that celebrate achievement can seep into our picture of God. Churches may spotlight winners and testimonies of success, while those who struggle go unnoticed. Over time, we learn that God’s favor is for the accomplished, and we hide our failures to stay in His good graces.
teaches: Paul writes, “God chose the foolish things of the world to shame the wise; God chose the weak things of the world to shame the strong. He chose the lowly and despised things of the world.” Jesus said, “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.” The psalmist says, “Better is the little of the righteous than the abundance of many who are wicked.” To Paul, God said, “My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is perfected in weakness.” God’s blessing is not reserved for winners.
self_statements: I have to succeed for God to bless me.
Failure puts me outside His favor.
I have not earned His blessing.
errors: Believing I am either a success or outside God’s blessing.
Insisting that I must achieve to deserve blessing.
Feeling like a failure and concluding God is distant.
Measuring my blessing against others’ achievements.
questions: Where did I learn that blessing is tied to success?
Whom did God choose in the Bible, and were they successful by the world’s standards?
What does Jesus say about the poor in spirit?
What blessings have I received that I did not earn?
What would it mean for God’s power to be perfected in my weakness?
Who could I be honest with about a struggle?
truth: God’s blessing is grace, not a reward for success. He often chooses the weak and lowly. I can bring my struggles to Him, knowing His power is made perfect in weakness.
hw_truths: He chooses the weak and lowly.
Blessed are the poor in spirit.
His power is perfected in weakness.
I do not have to succeed to be loved.
log: Each day, write one blessing you received that you did not earn.
actions: Write ten gifts you did not work for.
Share a struggle with a trusted friend.
Write it on a card and carry it.
Encourage a person who is struggling instead of a winner.
prayer: Lord, You choose the weak and the lowly. Free me from performing for Your favor. Let Your grace be sufficient and Your power be seen in my weakness. Amen.
hw_questions: Where did I learn blessing needs success?
What does weakness do for His power?
Who can I be honest with?
name_example: Sarah can write: “His grace is sufficient for me, and His power is perfected in my weakness.”
